notes.title: [1.4.0] Cats Go! 1/17 Update Notice
notes.notes:
📢[1.4.0] 1/17Update Notice

Hello, Cats Go! Players!
Thank you for your continued love and support for Cats Go!
We’re excited to share the main details of the [1.4.0] update, released on January 17th.


1. New Characters Added

Two unique and exciting new characters have been added!

- Bobo
(Unlock: Clear the [Shy Snowman] map)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169116/cf6355efe8825579c06282d161a3d386cb05d9d4.png
[olist]
 Trait: Moves slowly but boasts incredible strength.
 Special Skill: Attack power increases based on the amount of meat held.
[/olist]
- Catfy
(Unlock: Clear the [Autumn Night] map)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169116/bd8fdfb94d99086c6934773baceae3d840256220.png
[olist]
 Trait: Moves quickly but has relatively low attack power.
 특수 스킬:Special Skill: [Meat Giving] and [Upgrading] speeds are doubled.
[/olist]

2. Improved Character Selection Controls

 The character selection screen has been improved to provide a more convenient and user-friendly experience.


3. Steam Achievements Added

 Two new achievements for clearing specific maps have been added!
[Shy Snowman], [Autumn Night]


We hope you enjoy the new features and characters in Cats Go!
As always, your feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: [1.1.0] Cats Go! 11/27 Update Notice
notes.notes:
📢 11/27 Update Notice [1.1.0]
Hello, Cats Go players!

Here are the details of the [1.1.0] update on November 27th.

1. Two New Monsters Added

 Two new monsters have been added to the game.


2. Bomb Range Display Feature Added

 Bomb range is now displayed, allowing you to throw bombs more accurately to stop monsters and opposing players.


3. Meat Drop Feature When Stunned

 Players hit by poisonous mushrooms or bombs will drop a certain amount of meat when stunned.
(Throw bombs to steal meat from other players!)


4. Exit Confirmation Popup in Lobby

 A confirmation popup is now displayed when exiting the lobby.


5. Wave Waiting Time Adjusted Based on Player Count

 Wave waiting times are now automatically adjusted based on the number of players.


Enjoy a more strategic and exciting Cats Go experience with this update! 😊

Enjoy the enhanced Cats Go experience with this update!

notes.title: [1.0.2] Cats Go! 11/06 Update Notice
notes.notes:
📢 11/06 Update Notes [1.0.2]

Hello, Cats Go players!

Here are the details of the [1.0.2] update on November 6th.

1. New Maps   Two new maps have been added, each themed around winter and autumn. 

2. Attack Controls Update   Continuous attacks are now possible by holding down the basic attack key. 

3. Plant Turret Level Adjustment   The maximum level of the plant turret has been adjusted from 3 to 5. Modeling for the additional levels will be included in a future update. 

4. Sound Settings Added   New options to adjust master volume, background music, and sound effects are now available. 

5. In-Game Discord Access   You can now access the Discord channel easily from within the game. 

6. Automatic Controller Key Change   When a controller is connected, the key guide UI in-game will automatically adjust. 

7. Difficulty Adjustment   With the addition of Autumn (Normal) and Winter (Easy) modes, the difficulty of the original map (Hard) has been increased. 

Enjoy an even more exciting Cats Go experience with this update!

notes.title: [1.0.2] Cats Go! 11/5 Upcoming Update Notice
notes.notes:
📢 11/5 Upcoming Update Notice [1.0.2]

Hello, Cats Go! players!

Here’s an overview of the updates planned for November 5.

1. New Maps Added

 Various new maps will be added.

2. Z Button Hold for Continuous Attack

 Holding the Z button will allow for continuous attacks.

3. Plant Turret MAX Level Adjustment

 The maximum level for plant turrets will be adjusted to 5.

4. Sound ON/OFF Option Added to Settings

 A sound ON/OFF toggle option will be added to the settings menu.

5. In-Game Discord Access

 A feature will be added for easier access to the Discord channel from within the game.

6. Automatic Controller Key Configuration

 A function to automatically adjust key configuration upon controller connection will be introduced.


Look forward to an even better Cats Go! after this update!

notes.title: [1.0.1] Cats Go! 10/30 Update Notice
notes.notes:
📢 10/30 Update Notice [1.0.1]

Hello, Cats Go! players!

Here’s an overview of the updates from October 30.


1. Steam Deck Build Stabilization

 The game has been modified to run smoothly in the Steam Deck environment.

2. Improved Plant Turret Health Recovery and Upgrade Interaction

 The health recovery and upgrade process for plant turrets have been made more convenient.
Old: Pressing the button once triggers a single attack.
New: Pressing the button starts the attack, and pressing it again or moving will cancel it.

3. Change in In-Game Text

 The phrase "Game Start" in the main menu has been changed to "Quick Start."


Enjoy an even more fun Cats Go! with this update!
